audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 full-layer phases[N].side were the placeholder "Skill" while content win[N] already carried the real verdict (Tristana x6, Ezreal at 2+ items) matching the packet's levelChart exactly.
audit.why: Tristana's passive range plus Rocket Jump (W) make her the lane bully through levels 1-5/first item; Ezreal only takes over once max-range Q and kiting punish her post-jump immobility with two items.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-5].side to Tristana and phases[6].side to Ezreal, and rewrote phases[0-5].why (which described the owner winning) to match, grounded in Rocket Jump and Explosive Charge. phases[6].why already matched the Ezreal verdict and was left alone.

audit.why: Spikes: Tristana's Rocket Jump/Explosive Charge all-in from level 2-5, Buster Shot (R) at 6 adding a knockback set-up, her attack-speed item spike shredding you in one jump, and Ezreal's two-item kite window flipping it late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions packet flags that Rocket Jump (W) grounds — it can deny Arcane Shift (E) if she jumps first — and this was never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Tristana's W kit flag is "grounding: shuts off enemy dashes," which directly denies Ezreal's E dash per Ezreal's own kit flag ("dash: mobility that grounding and walls can deny").
audit.corrected: Stated the grounding interaction in breakdown.trading and dosFull[1].d.
